annotations.title: Get stories with active matched event-contract markets

description: Storyflo stories that match an actively traded event contract on Kalshi (a CFTC-regulated exchange). Each item carries qualitative signal tags (high_velocity, genuine_uncertainty) plus a link-out to Kalshi's own page where the live market data lives. Editorial sourcing surface, not market-data redistribution: Storyflo never returns raw prices, market-implied probabilities, volumes, or open interest in this payload. Use this when the agent needs to know which Storyflo stories are about news themes that have an actively traded event contract — e.g. World Cup matches, political mention contracts, corporate events. Filter by story vertical, Kalshi category (Politics, Economics, Companies, Science and Technology, Sports), or by signal tag.

category.description: Filter by Kalshi event category (e.g. Politics, Economics, Companies, Sports)

signal.description: Filter by qualitative signal tag. high_velocity = the matched market is repricing meaningfully in the last 24h; genuine_uncertainty = the market sits in the 40–60% band where it itself is uncertain.

vertical.description: Filter by story vertical (e.g. news, finance, tech, crypto)
